ctx.spec.known: Grey menu entry (HR); {adduct} = adduct or "m/z only", {more} = " and N others" or empty.
ctx.spec.iso.tip: Description of the formula field; the name comes from the contaminants list.
ctx.ask.sug.label: Accessible label of the list of suggestions below the field; they are names from the contaminants list.
ctx.ask.sug.n: Announcement for screen readers; {n} = number of names proposed.
ctx.spec.isoRes.prompt: "auto" is a word to type in the field: it stays "auto" in both languages.
ctx.libSearch: Entry of the right-click menu on the MS2 spectrum.
ctx.spec.openMs2: Right-click entry on a spectrum peak; {mz} = precursor m/z of the MS² scan.
ctx.spec.extractMs2: Right-click entry on a peak of a Full Scan spectrum (low resolution) whose m/z is the precursor of loaded MS2 scans.
ctx.spec.extractMs2.aria: Label for screen readers; {mz} = peak m/z.
ctx.spec.openMs2.aria: Label for screen readers; {mz} = peak m/z.
ctx.map.where: First (grey) row of the right-click menu on the map; {rt} = RT, {mz} = m/z, {file} = sample.
ctx.map.xic: Right-click menu on the map; {mz} = m/z.
ctx.map.addTo: Right-click menu on the map; {mz} = m/z, {panel} = title of the XIC panel.
ctx.spec.cont.aria: Accessible name of the "Is it a known contaminant?" entry of the spectrum menu; {mz} = peak m/z.
ctx.spec.copy.aria: "Copy value" entry of the right-click menu on the spectrum; {mz} = peak m/z.
ctx.spec.xic: Right-click menu on the spectrum; {mz} = peak m/z.
ctx.spec.knownMore: Tail of the "Known contaminant" entry; {n} = how many other contaminants match.
ctx.spec.overlay: Right-click menu on the spectrum; {name} = name of the XIC, {n} = panel number.
ctx.spec.annotate.prompt: Question for writing an annotation on a peak; {mz} = peak m/z.
ctx.spec.iso.fail: Error in the isotope profile; {message} = technical text.
ctx.chrom.where: First (grey) row of the right-click menu on the chromatogram; {rt} = RT in minutes, {file} = sample.
ctx.annotate.prompt: Question for writing an annotation on the chromatogram; {rt} = retention time.
ctx.ann.edit: Right-click menu on an annotation; {text} = annotation text.
ctx.ann.delete: Right-click menu on an annotation; {text} = annotation text.
ctx.spec.generate: Entry of the right-click menu on a peak of an HR spectrum; {mz} = peak m/z. Opens the elemental composition panel.
ctx.uv.where: Header row of the UV spectrum menu; {nm} = wavelength under the pointer.
ctx.uv.wlAt: Entry of the UV spectrum menu that opens the DAD trace at a wavelength; {nm} = wavelength under the pointer, rounded.
etpk.nm: Wavelength in nanometers in the label of a PDA/UV peak (e.g. "14.26 · 254 nm"); {v} = wavelength.
etpk.tip.int: Tooltip of the label of a chromatogram peak; {y} = apex intensity.
